Card Q&A.a: Yes, it also treats the Tamer as a Digimon when it digivolves. It treats it as a Digimon that digivolves, therefore "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects will trigger.  In addition, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect activates, digivolution won't be possible using this effect that also treats the Tamer as a Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: Does a "may digivolve this card as if the Tamer is a Digimon" effect also treat the Tamer that will become a digivolution card as a Digimon when it digivolves?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you perform a digivolution bonus draw.  A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.
Card Q&A.q: Is a digivolution bonus draw performed even when a Tamer digivolves?

Card Q&A.a: No, it can't.  Even if a card digivolves from a card that was placed on the field in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn. It can only attack in the turns after it's played.
Card Q&A.q: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack in the same turn?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it becomes a digivolution card.  If that Digimon would leave the field, the Tamer card will be trashed like a normal digivolution card.
Card Q&A.q: Does a Tamer card placed under a Digimon become a digivolution card?

Card Q&A.q: Can I choose an opponent's Digimon with a "can't attack" effect as the target when I activate this card's [When Digivolving] effect?

Card Q&A.a: You activate the 1st effect from among the simultaneously triggered effects and attack.  The 2nd effect can be activated before the counter timing, but because you can't declare another attack during an attack, you won't be able to attack using the 2nd effect, even if you activate it.
Card Q&A.q: What happens if there are multiple "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks" effects and they trigger simultaneously?

Card Q&A.a: You can give that effect to such Digimon, but if the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the gained effect won't trigger.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to give "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks" to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. For this card's 1st effect, you declare a digivolution, then upon revealing this card, you can also choose a Tamer as the card to digivolve, and that Tamer is also treated as a level 3 Digimon. As with the normal digivolution procedure, after revealing this card and declaring a digivolution, you can't choose to not digivolve. In addition, you can't declare digivolution into this card in the first place unless there is a card on the field that you can digivolve.
